description: Show pets to adopt near a place as an interactive view: photos, facts, and a button to meet one at its rescue. Use it when someone wants to look at pets in a place we list (see the server instructions). Apps without interactive views get the same list as text.

age.description: Taiwan says only Young or Adult

country.description: TW (Taiwan), US (King County WA, Montgomery County MD only), ES (Zaragoza), AT (Vienna, found pets only) or JP (Fukushima Prefecture). Not needed with near

good_with.description: Only pets whose listing says so; rarely stated

lang.description: The person's language: en, es, zh-Hant, zh-Hans, ko, ja, vi, fr, ar, tl (default en)

near.description: a Taiwan county or township in any language, a US ZIP, Zaragoza, Wien or Fukushima (福島県) (98101, 信義區, 臺北市), or lat,lon; never a street address. Nearest first; an uncovered place gets the nearest pets we hold, marked not nearby

q.description: Words in the person's language: breeds, colors, ages, sizes, sex and places become filters, the rest is full-text ("黑色柴犬")

size.description: Not stated in King County or Vienna

name: show_pets
title: Show pets to adopt
